sources.text: Burkart Laboratory Welcome to Burkart Laboratory The Burkart Group Over the past decade, the Burkart lab has developed several technologies to study secondary metabolites and their producer organisms. Area of Focus Our area of focus is the enzymatic megasynthases responsible for synthesizing fatty acids, polyketides, and nonribosomal peptides. Biochemical technologies Using various chemical, biochemical, and proteomic techniques, we are uncovering protein•protein interactions that occur between domains of these enzymatic complexes. Applications Applications include drug discovery, renewable energy, and biomaterials. ‌ No Code Website Builder
